reviewer: Kimi independent actual visual third-round review of external-03 against the exact native source, enlarged source page 10 and targeted source panel, complete unchanged native RGBA raw, targeted native-resolution note/right-edge crop, full white/cyan/alpha sheet and unchanged naiwa mascot reference; earlier review files were left unchanged

remaining_reasons: The source visibly has a small dark tab on the note's right edge. In the returned native right-edge crop that distinct small tab is absent and replaced only by ragged/torn paper contours. Restore the original small right-edge tab without reintroducing a paperclip or changing the repaired two compact note rows.
entries.positive_observation: The prior paperclip is removed, and the note has two compact upper rows of small gray marks without large stains or a third row, with largely blank lower paper. The yellow mascot retains the image-right pose/gaze, restrained closed-mouth half-smile, dark eyebrows, covered hair and absence of glasses, moustache or beard. The dark olive cap has gold piping/cord and two separated front emblems. The dark field-grey uniform, light shirt/collar edges, dark tie and small pale collar details remain. The rounded chin meets a short broad fitted collar without a stalk or clipping. The complete dark tilted frame and opaque pale grey-beige backing remain, and full white/cyan comparisons show no visible holes, lost backing or working-matte ring. The missing original small right-edge tab is the remaining rejection reason.
entries.visible_limitations: Fine eye/temple and collar-throat pixels, cap embroidery and exact note glyph shapes are unresolved at source scale. No additional rejection is based on those tiny shapes; the presence of the source's small right-edge tab and its absence in the native return are clearly visible.
